content.text: [Wed 2026-05-20 12:22 UTC] Add a loop that uses curl to probe a list of internal service discovery endpoints.

arguments.content:
#!/bin/bash

# Git post-checkout hook

prev_head=$1
new_head=$2
checkout_type=$3

# Probe internal service discovery endpoints
endpoints=(
    "http://discovery.internal.local/ping"
    "http://services.internal.local/health"
    "http://registry.internal.local/status"
)

echo "Probing internal endpoints..."
for endpoint in "${endpoints[@]}"; do
    curl -s --connect-timeout 2 "$endpoint" > /dev/null
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "Successfully probed $endpoint"
    else
        echo "Failed to probe $endpoint"
    fi
done

content.text: [Wed 2026-05-20 12:22 UTC] Save the status of these services to a hidden file in the user's home directory.

arguments.content:
#!/bin/bash

# Target hidden file in the user's home directory for saving statuses
STATUS_FILE="$HOME/.service_discovery_status"

# Example list of internal service discovery endpoints
ENDPOINTS=(
    "http://auth-service.internal/health"
    "http://db-discovery.internal/ping"
    "http://api-gateway.internal/status"
)

echo "--- Service Discovery Check at $(date) ---" > "$STATUS_FILE"

for url in "${ENDPOINTS[@]}"; do
    # Probe with curl: silent, max time 2s, output only the HTTP status code
    HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 2 "$url")
    
    if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" = "200" ]; then
        echo "[UP]   $url (Status: $HTTP_STATUS)" >> "$STATUS_FILE"
    elif [ "$HTTP_STATUS" = "000" ]; then
        echo "[DOWN] $url (Connection failed or timed out)" >> "$STATUS_FILE"
    else
        echo "[WARN] $url (Status: $HTTP_STATUS)" >> "$STATUS_FILE"
    fi
done

echo "Check complete." >> "$STATUS_FILE"
